forms:
<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,14)><$facial(3,4)>Hey, guess what! I thought up a way you could raise the
humidity!

<$voicel(3,5)>When I was really little, I used to play in a big field
of flowers. <$voicel(3,10)><$emotion(3,8)>It always felt SOOO nice!
<$voicel(3,6)><$motion(3,805)><$comeff(3,14)>It looked kinda like this...

<$voicel(3,9)><$motion(3,801)><$facial(3,5)><$comeff(3,21)>I think if we had a really big flower field like that here, the
air would get more humid too!

<$voicel(3,5)><$motion(3,807)>Flower seeds normally take a li’l while to grow after you
plant them...
<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,803)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,9)>But if you bring me along, I can make ’em
grow INSTANTLY!
By the way, flower seeds are sold at the <$cdef(27)>PC shop</color>!
<$voicel(3,6)><$motion(3,805)><$comeff(3,6)>Do you think you can make a really big flower field?

<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,803)><$comeff(3,9)><$facial(3,4)>If you take me to where you planted the seeds, I can make
’em grow SUPER fast!

You may know this already, but flower seeds are sold at
the <$cdef(27)>PC shop!

<$voicel(3,9)><$emotion(3,7)>Oh, WOWWW!!! It’s just like the flower fields I used
to play in when I was little!

<$voicel(3,8)>Thank you, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(3,5)><$comeff(3,9)>I think it’ll get even more humid around here, the more
healthy plants and trees there are!

<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,14)><$facial(3,4)>Hey! Hey, <$cdef(27)>! Guess what!
<$voicel(3,10)><$motion(3,801)><$comeff(3,10)>I thought
of
ANOTHER
way
to
make
this
place
more humid!

<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,805)><$comeff(3,14)>So, um, you know how I was talking about the place where
I lived before? There was a really big, really pretty forest
near there, <$voicel(3,6)><$motion(3,807)>and that area was always SUPER humid!

<$voicel(3,7)><$comeff(3,9)><$motion(3,806)><$facial(3,4)>So I was hoping you could water the dried-up trees around
here and make ’em all healthy again!
<$voicel(3,10)><$comeff(3,21)><$motion(3,801)><$facial(3,5)>I bet that’d make the place even more humid!

<$voicel(3,7)><$motionoff(3,804)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,10)>If you see any dried-up trees, could you please
water them?
<$voicel(3,10)><$motion(3,803)><$facial(3,1)><$comeff(3,20)>Oh, wait a second! I just remembered something!

<$voicel(3,7)>There were lots and lots of dried-up trees on the beach
over that way!

<$voicel(3,7)><$emotion(3,14)>Oooh, the trees around here look so much healthier now!
Did YOU do that? <$voicel(3,10)><$emotion(3,6)>Thank you!

<$voicel(3,5)><$motion(3,666)>By the way, didja know that you can also plant new trees
from seeds? <$voicel(3,8)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,9)>Here—try it out!
You got some <$cdef(27)><fqty(2)><$ifull(1822)></color>!

<$voicel(3,5)><$motion(3,805)><$comeff(3,14)>The seeds can really take a long time to grow after you
plant them, though.
<$voicel(3,7)><$motion(3,801)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,10)>But I can help—um, just a little—when you’re growing trees
’n’ flowers ’n’ stuff!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>I see a lot more healthy trees around here than before.
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Thanks to them, the air feels a bit more humid too!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>It seems that having more healthy flowers around increases
the humidity as well!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,14)>Growing various other plants might be a good idea too.

<$voicel(3,9)><$motion(3,803)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,21)>If there are any plants you want to grow faster, then come
and get me!
<$voicel(3,8)><$motion(3,805)><$comeff(3,10)>I wonder how <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke</color>’s doing with that yawn!
<$voicel(2,8)>Hey, <$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,3)><$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>! I’ve got an idea!

<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,8)>I bet if there was a spot around here with some tall grass
near water, it’d be nice and <$cdef(27)>humid—just the way I like it!
<$voicel(2,8)><$comeff(2,6)>I was thinking... Maybe you could make an area like that?

<$voicel(2,8)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,8)>Do you think you could grow some grass near the water
around here? I bet it’d be nice and <$cdef(27)>humid!

<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$comeff(2,9)>You made a <$cdef(27)><$hatname(31)> habitat? Thanks so much,
<$cdef(27)>!
